title: Very-small HITL UAV low-flight exemption source (rules chapter 4.5.2/4.5.3)

clear_weather_min_visibility_percent.raw: Manned aircraft cannot fly at SSkim altitude at night or less than clear weather (40% visibility or more).
clear_weather_min_visibility_percent.note: the page's printed clear-weather boundary; the parent movement_limits gate (:461) already encodes the same printed threshold for the order gate

daylight.raw: Very small, HITL UAVs (drones) can fly at SSkim/NOE during daylight and clear weather without restrictions.
daylight.note: engine day/night is a printed two-state input (Altitude Bands page companion text; DayNight::Day)

sskim_noe_band_max_m.note: documented reference; the <=20 m branch already exists in parent safety_step, this leaf does not re-check altitude

exemption.raw: Very small, HITL UAVs (drones) can fly at SSkim/NOE during daylight and clear weather without restrictions.

larger_uavs.raw: Larger UAVs must roll on the SSkim/NOE table every Tactical Turn.
larger_uavs.note: parent safety_step already rolls every Tactical Turn for every non-exempt low aircraft; no change or duplicate implementation

bans.sskim: UAVs cannot fly at SSkim altitude. (4.5.2)
bans.noe: Unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) cannot fly at NOE altitude. (4.5.3)

eligibility_requires_all: author_micro: explicit scenario-author micro qualification for the exact class id; never inferred from model name, unmanned label or automation
actual_unmanned: actual rules §2.5 unmanned hardware fit configured
hitl_live_link: established HITL with a live control link (covers lost link, autonomous mode, one-turn transitions and loss states via the existing can_control gate)
policy.none_config: no Configuration (or class not declared micro): unchanged legacy low-flight roll for every aircraft
policy.no_new_probability: this table and leaf restate no crash table, no percentage and no rounding; the printed SSkim/NOE Crash Chance table remains solely in the parent tables/low_flight data
policy.no_real_platform_micro_claim: no real DB class (including us_mq4c/us_mq25a) is declared micro; experimental micro airframes are explicit scenario_assumption laboratory declarations

pre_ruling_boundary: The 4.5.2 flat SSkim/NOE UAV bans and the 4.5.3 very-small-HITL exemption plus larger-UAV roll paragraph are a printed tension. Batch ruling applied here: the exemption sentence grants explicit day+clear permission ('without restrictions'); larger UAVs keep the every-Tactical-Turn roll; None/incomplete keeps the legacy roll. Reconciliation beyond this is not claimed.

cross_reference.unmanned_control_source: real control-link facts for us_mq4c/us_mq25a live in data/rules/unmanned-annex-2025.json and the root Annex L registry; those certify control fits, not micro eligibility
cross_reference.unmanned_public_gates_used: is_configured / can_control (unmanned2026) and the set_satellite_available referee producer; no state poking
